sara (People Ops): Heads-up: cycle timeline updated in the tracker. Please re-sync before finalizing manager notes.
tom (Eng Manager): Saw the update. Any change to freeze date?
sara (People Ops): Freeze unchanged: 2024-06-21 23:59 PT. We added a short exceptions flow for short-term LOA that starts during signoff.
priya (IC): If LOA starts mid-signoff, do managers mark "partial_review"?
sara (People Ops): Yes mark "partial_review" and include LOA dates in the evidence doc. People Ops will flag it for adjusted expectations during calibration.
jen (Total Rewards): Note: promo comp bands will be withheld for folks on active PIP until review completes. We annotate the tracker so payroll doesn't process changes prematurely.
tom (Eng Manager): For calibration prep, are managers expected to bring raw peer feedback or summaries? I have sensitive DMs.
sara (People Ops): Bring summarized evidence (2-3 bullets) and link to redacted source if needed. If it's Slack DMs, paste into a doc and remove names.
review-bot: Reminder: calibration facilitator signups close in 72 hours.
priya (IC): Quick ask: can People Ops populate the tracker with probation flags for hires in the last 90 days?
sara (People Ops): Yes we can auto-fill probation_status if HRIS has start dates. Send an export request by EOD.
jen (Total Rewards): Managers: avoid including compensation suggestions in the packet. Compensation will propose ranges after calibration decisions.
tom (Eng Manager): If a manager and calibration chair disagree, what's the escalation path?
sara (People Ops): Escalate to the calibration committee lead via people-ops@redwood.com within 48h of the panel. Committee reviews evidence; People Ops records the final outcome.
priya (IC): Will there be a manager FAQ refresh? New managers on my team could use it.
sara (People Ops): Yes updated Manager FAQ and a 12-minute primer video go live this afternoon on the checklist page.
jen (Total Rewards): FYI: comp letters timeline usually 7-12 business days after calibration clears comp review. We'll communicate team-specific ETA post-calibration.
tom (Eng Manager): One more: is there a CSV of missing self-assessments we can pull?
sara (People Ops): Yes s3://people-ops/exports/missing_selfs_2024-06.csv. If you need AWS access ping infra-ops.
priya (IC): Thanks 44b
sara (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll post a one-line checklist in #general at noon. Ping us for exceptions.
